analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA transaminase inhibition raises GABA levels, but these cell lines express little GABAergic machinery, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other GABA-pathway modulators, with only low similarity to unrelated classes.
